Frequently Asked Questions

What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

We offer flexible MOQ, so startups and growing brands can test the market before committing to a large run. Tell us the style and quantity you have in mind and we confirm the exact MOQ in your quote.

Do you offer free samples?

No. Samples are paid, so every sample is made to the same standard as bulk. You approve the sample before bulk production starts, and sample terms are confirmed in your quote. The consultation and quote are free.

Can you manufacture products under my own brand?

Yes. We provide complete OEM and private label manufacturing, including custom logos, labels, packaging, colors, materials, sizing and specifications.

I have never manufactured overseas. Will you guide me?

Yes. We guide you through every stage, from product development and sampling to production, quality inspection and shipping, whether it is your first brand or your first international order.

How do I know bulk production will match the approved sample?

Every project follows a structured approval process. We review your specifications, make a sample, and begin bulk production only after you approve it. Our goal is for the final product to match the approved sample as closely as possible.

What if I do not know which materials or specifications to choose?

That is completely normal. Our team helps you choose materials, construction methods, sizing and finishing based on your product, budget and target market.

How do I know I will receive genuine materials?

If we specify genuine leather or a particular fabric, that is exactly what we manufacture with. We do not substitute materials without discussing it with you first.

How will I know what is happening with my order?

You get regular production updates and transparent communication throughout, so you are never left wondering about progress.

Can I customize every detail of my product?

Depending on the product category, you can customize logos, colors, materials, sizing, labels, packaging, trims, stitching details and more.

How long does production take?

It depends on the product type, quantity and level of customization. Once we review your requirements, we give you a realistic production schedule before manufacturing begins.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes. We manufacture for customers worldwide and arrange international shipments to many countries, including the USA, United Kingdom, Canada and Qatar.

What happens if my order arrives damaged?

We replace the product. Replacements are not shipped free of cost, and we agree the details with you before anything goes out. For any other issue with an order, we work with you to find a fair solution.

Will my designs remain confidential?

Yes. We treat your product designs, branding and business information as confidential.

How do payments work?

Payment terms are agreed before production begins. Production typically starts after an agreed advance payment, with the balance settled before or at shipment.

Can you help me develop a completely new product?

Yes. If you already have a concept, design or reference sample, we work with you to develop a production-ready product and refine the specifications where needed.

I am starting a new brand. Is Amelia Impex the right partner?

Yes. We support startups with practical guidance, flexible MOQ and scalable manufacturing, and we also work with retailers, distributors and established companies.

Why choose Amelia Impex over other manufacturers?

You work directly with the factory, with premium craftsmanship, transparent communication, flexible MOQ and personal support from sample to shipment.

About Amelia Impex

Founder-Led Sports & Fitness Manufacturer Since 2002

Founded in 2002 by Sheikh Irfan Ali Riaz, Amelia Impex helps startups, growing brands and established businesses bring premium sportswear, fitness apparel, motorcycle gear, leatherwear and custom products to market through factory-direct OEM and private-label manufacturing.

Our founder came from hospitality, where every detail decides whether a guest returns. He built Amelia Impex on that standard: quality you can verify, honest communication, realistic timelines and long-term partnerships.

Every product carries someone's reputation. We handle yours that way.
